spans.s:
n. (-नं)
Tying up, hanging.
E.
उद् and वन्धन tying.

mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु)
1 Having the arms lifted up.
2 Having the trunk upraised (as an elephant.)
E.
उद् and वाहु the arm.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Blown, budded.
2 Reminded, made to think of or recalled.
3 Awaked.
E.
उद् forth, up, and वुद्ध known.

m. (-रः)
Association of ideas recalling any thing to remembrance.
E.
उद्वद्ध and संस्कार faculty.

Reminding.
E.
उद् and बोध knowledge.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Discovering, exhibiting.
2 What reminds, or calls to remembrance.
E.
उद and बोधक making known.

n. (-नं)
1 Recalling, reminding.
2 Awaking, arousing.
E.
उद् before बुध to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
